rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Desktop proxy application that federates hundreds of MCP servers while bypassing API limits. Provides intelligent BM25-based tool discovery, automatic quarantine protection against malicious servers, and massive token reduction through on-demand tool loading. Cross-platform native binaries with system-tray UI, OAuth authentication support, Docker isolation, and HTTPS with mutual TLS.
